_how: Written by the Studio's Save button (dev only). Hand-edit it and reload the page: `entries` become the spawned shapes, `ordinal` is the next spawn number, `sheetId` and `cameraKey` are the tools' context. An entry needs id, kind (cube | sphere | flat-square | flat-circle), theatreKey (4+ chars, unique in the sheet), and position/rotation/scale as [x,y,z] — rotation in radians. Unknown keys are dropped; a malformed entry fails the whole load, and the dev server answers 400 naming the field.
